import React from 'react'; import '../styles/StatsPanel.css'; function StatsPanel({ products }) { const totalProducts = products.length; const totalItems = products.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.quantity, 0); const totalValue = products.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.quantity * p.price), 0); const lowStockCount = products.filter(p => p.quantity > 0 && p.quantity < 20).length; const outOfStockCount = products.filter(p => p.quantity === 0).length; return (
📊
Total Products {totalProducts}
📦
Total Items {totalItems}
💰
Total Value ${totalValue.toFixed(2)}
⚠️
Low Stock Items {lowStockCount}
🚫
Out of Stock {outOfStockCount}
); } export default StatsPanel;
